description: This file defines a frontend API wrapper (BackendApi) that encapsulates REST API calls to a backend server for operations like health check, user signup/login, module listing, exam configuration, starting exam attempts, fetching questions, and submitting answers. It manages HTTP requests, handles errors, and provides a consistent interface for other parts of the frontend to interact with the backend services.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check to the backend, returning a message indicating server status.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and optional full name, returning access token info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning access token info.

methods.name: listModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available modules, mapping backend data to UI model, including a default question count.

methods.name: getModuleExamConfig
methods.description: Fetches exam configuration details for a specific module, mapping backend response to frontend format.

methods.name: startExamAttempt
methods.description: Starts an exam attempt for a given module, returning attempt details with timing and status.

methods.name: getExamQuestions
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a module's exam, converting backend data to frontend question structure.

methods.name: submitExamAttempt
methods.description: Submits answers for an exam attempt, returning results including score, pass/fail, and correct choices. Includes error handling for unimplemented backend.
